Thabo Bester Mystery

By: Busisiwe Gumede | Delivery

Proposal


Show: Carte Blanche

Unique Selling Point:
It was widely reported that Thabo Bester, convicted rapist and murderer, was killed during a fire in Mangaung Prison in May last year. But GroundUp revealed the body found was dead before the fire broke out. The autopsy report obtained by them showed that it was because of blunt force injury. And that the police docket relating to the matter had been changed from suicide to murder. Several sources and leaks unveiled further suspicious circumstances around the fire…


Summary:
That Betser was moved to a corner cell of the prison before the fire broke out, the cell was located where CCTV cameras could not look into.
The man who died, did not die from the fire but rather the blow to the head.
Minutes before the prison fire, two people were seen leaving the prison
CCTV cameras where not positioned properly on the morning of the fire
The autopsy report puts the heit of the body 25 centimeters shorter than Betser’s prison mugshot.
The DNA of the body did not match that of the woman who claimed to be Bester’s mother. She had tried to claim the body.
The body has not confirmed whether the body has been positively identified as Bester or not.
The involvement of celebrity doctor Nandipha Mangudumana with a big social media following. She filed a case with the Pretoria High Court two days after the fire, claiming to be Bester’s customary wife, so that she can conduct her own investigations.
Images of a man who looks like Bester submitted by an anonymous source in Sandton City. the picture appears to be of Thabo Bester and he seems to be accompanied by the celebrity doctor. This picture was taken on the 30th of June 2022 and the fire broke out on the 3rd of June 2022. Two months after the fire.
The Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services has been investigating the Thabo Bester issue. At this stage the watchdog body says it's investigating all possible angles of the story. But they rely a lot on information provided by the police and correctional services. They cannot confirm until the police investigation is complete. The body says it's very concerned about the mounting evidence presented by the media and the public.


Further information:
These allegations imply that a lot of people may have been involved in the alleged escape of Bester. It's an unsolved mystery that has Bester’s victims and those who say they have had encounters with the man worried.

Press Release:


Zolile Sekeleni shuffled into the Bloemfontein Magistrates Court on Tuesday. Old and weathered, he looked a little bemused by all the attention from the media scrum. Just days before, Sekeleni could’ve passed for a concerned parent whose beloved daughter was accused of being an accomplice to one of South Africa’s most daring prison escapes. Now, he along with a former prison warden Senohe Matsoara stood in court, facing serious charges including murder. But this is a story that began more than a year ago. At the centre of it, a convicted murderer and serial rapist, with friends in all the right places and a lover, who was willing to do anything to help him escape prison. Sekeleni’s fate is intricately tied to his wayward daughter, a once successful doctor Dr Nandipha Magudumana, who’s decision to help the convict, Thabo Bester walk out of the G4S maximum security prison in Bloemfontein, unleashed a violent trail of murder, arson and a final dash for freedom in Tanzania. Carte Blanche goes behind the headlines in a story that’s left most South Africans shocked and horrified.

Script:



“It is an embarrassing incident of security breach

NEWZROOM AFRIKA

Xoli Mngambi - Newzroom Africa

1 INTRO: Serial scammer to convicted rapist and murderer.

“Questions about whether the facebook rapist is alive or not are intensifying “ - Clement Manyathela - NEWZROOM AFRIKA

On the run from a justice system blindsided by a sensational prison-break.

“Reports have surfaced that bester may be alive and escaped from prison” NEWZROOM AFRIKA

Then… an arrest thousands of kms from where he made his escape… his softly spoken accomplice at his side.

His girlfriend, Dr Nandipha Magudumana, touched down here at Lanceria airport”
SABC NEWS

The villain back behind bars, uncomfortable questions now being asked of prison officials - their answers exposing the rot at a privately-run facility.

UPSOUND - GLYNNIS

“This escape of Hollywood proportions was done with the help of three people?” PARLIAMENT

Now, a story that ranks as one of the country’s most sordid of recent times is told from the inside - by a fellow inmate of the man they call the Facebook Rapist: Thabo Bester.

DIP TO BLACK
CHRISELDA LEWIS NEWS FOOTAGE WITH UPS
An undignified return to South Africa for a couple who for months thumbed their noses at authority.(PAUSE)

UPS: Chriselda’s question: “Anything to say Nandipha? ANything to say?

At Bester’s side, his alleged accomplice Dr Nandipha Madugamana.

Arrested in Tanzania - close to the border with Kenya - they were flown back to the country on board a chartered plane.

Car drives off

Separated from her fellow fugitive, Dr Nandipha was taken to a holding cell before appearing in court.


A celebrity doctor with expensive taste, Nandipha Madugamana, has known Bester since university. After his conviction for murder and rape, she began visiting him in prison.

BREATHE
3 He’d been serving time since 2012 - some would say a fitting end for a man who’d long demonstrated a criminal instinct.

Through his teens he’d run petty scams and used social media to lure women… before raping and robbing them.

With the police on his trail, he’d enticed another woman - Nomfundo Tyholo - into his grasp. He raped and then murdered her.

PAUSE

It was this unthinkable crime that led to his conviction… and how he crossed paths with one of the country’s leading Forensic Psychologists, Dr Gerard Labuschagne.


VIDEO CLIP UPSOUND – Thabo interviewed by Dr Labuschagne – strap the video with the year 2011

4 Dr Labuschagne interviewed Bester ahead of his first court appearance.

15:31 - I’m sitting in a position where I want this thing to pass as soon as possible…

Gerard – 14:05 – 14:16
I think that’s Thabo Bester in his purest conman formwhen did you decide you don’t want to put people through suffering? Because you’ve been putting people through suffering quite a lot, very repeatedly, in various different ways for years.

14:28 - 14:41
Now we must suddenly believe you, that you feel very bad about what you've done?
It's nonsense.
4 Bester was sentenced to life for Tyholo’s murder, 50-years on two counts of rape and a further 15 for armed robbery.



But, if he had his way - as he very nearly did - he had no intention of serving that sentence. A decade into his time behind bars, Bester would stage a prison escape so brazen, so audacious, that it defied belief.
5. LINK - Initially authorities believed Thabo Bester died after setting himself alight in May last year. But DNA tests revealed the charred remains found in the convicted rapist and murderer’s cell belonged to someone else. But this was information that prisoners inside knew before it was made public.
6. In a plan that reads like a movie script, it appears that a body - still not identified - was smuggled into Bester’s cell before being set alight.

In the fire’s aftermath the official line remained that Bester had died in the flames. Others, though, knew better.

This prisoner, who we’ll call Inmate X, shared the same unit as Bester, and claims the events leading to the fire were suspicious.

So scared about the consequences of talking to us, he insisted we hide his identity.

PAUSE

We’ve asked an actor to voice what Inmate X told us in our recorded interview.


SOUND UP - PRISONER EX.

32:48 The manner in which I know him, he was very quiet guy but you could see that he has
everything. he was
carrying a roll of money. He said if you have money you will get everything.
7. Inmate X tells us that, after initially being held in the prison’s common area, Bester was mysteriously moved into solitary confinement on the 30th of April last year.
UPSOUND - Inmate X

05:44 There was something unusual that happened.
06:00 There was a guy staying in cell 35, whom before Bester arrived, the guy was then told to leave that cell. Then the guy refused, wanting to know the reasons behind it.
8.He was forced out to make way for Bester. Now a resident of Cell 35, the infamous Facebook rapist told anyone who asked that his stay would be a short one.
UPSOUND X - INMATE

08:20 He was staying there as an own safety and we kept on going to him to ask how he was. But
he mentioned something whereby he said to me,‘I’m just here, but soon I’ll be gone’.


PAUSE…
10. Then, just 3 days after being moved - in the early hours of the 3rd of May - the prisoners were woken by an explosion.
SOUND UP - INMATE X

09:37 As we were sleeping, around 2am, just after 2am that’s when we heard an explosion. 09:54 After that explosion we all woke up, even other inmates. 10:00 We could all smell the petrol and opened the windows while questioning what was going on. Everyone could smell the petrol, but we didn’t know where it was coming from.


11. Inmate X says he and the other prisoners pushed the panic buttons in their cells while smoke billowed from cell 35.
12 VO Then, about 30 minutes later… more panic.
INMATE X

11:33 “Between 20 to 40 minutes later we heard a second explosion…worse than the first one. The other guys in front where now screaming for help. 14:24 “We then overheard from the nurses that he is dead.”


13. That “he” was Bester - or so they thought.
14. While prison officials stuck to their conclusions, it didn’t take much for the inmates to draw their own: the charred remains in cell 35 didn’t belong to Bester.
SOUND UP - INMATE X


32:26 they knew because some of them he told them that he will be leaving.


VO 13 – But whose body did they carry out of cell 35? And, just as crucially, how did it get into this maximum security prison in the first place? The answer, says Inmate X, might lie in the arrival before the fire of a mysterious wooden box.
INMATE X

22:20 “This wooden kist was taken from the bakkie to the kitchen.


VO 14 Could it be that Whatever or WHOMever was inside the kist was rolled into cell 35 on the evening of the fire…and later… rolled out by senior officials?


BREATHER
VO Thabo Bester was now at large.
BREATHER


VO: And yet, that a convicted rapist and murder was on the loose was kept from the public. The question is: why?
OUR SOURCES SAY THAT PRISON OFFICIALS KNEW ABOUT THIS EARLIER…
BREATHER
The government spends nearly a billion rand a month on the London-listed security giant G4S to run two private prisons in South Africa.

Police and Prisons Civil Rights Union spokesperson Richard Mamabolo believes the months-long cover-up is a sign of the corruption in private prisons.

RICHARD MAMABOLO - POPCRU

05:03 – ..., it's humanly impossible for anybody to escape from that prison except through the help of perhaps the individuals and…you had to get the body inside the prison, into the cell again and you had to then get Mr Bester out.
BREATHER OVER GVs
UPS RUTH
Author & journalist Ruth Hopkins has investigated the prison system - and Mangaung in particular for a decade. She co-produced a documentary called, Prison for Profit.


RUTH HOPKINS – AUTHOR

01:56 –... prisoners started telling me stories about widespread torture, forced injections with antipsychotic drugs and murder that had taken place in the prison, a lot of other suspicious deaths.

05:55 – ...I visited about 20, 25 prisons in South Africa for my work and I would say Mangaung prison is a most violent and cruel prison, a most lawless prison that I’ve come across.


Inmate X says he tried and failed to raise the alarm with prison authorities about the fire and what he believed to be Bester’s escape.


SOUND UP - PRISONER X

30:12 I’ve got a letter which I wrote to the controllers on the 11th of July, whereby I demanded to see them with regards to this thing of Bester.
30:16 I asked them: ‘what are your thoughts with regard to this? Because this is not suicide, this is is an escape.’


Far from taking action, Inmate X says his identity was exposed and his safety compromised.


He was transferred from Mangaung Prison to another facility.


BREATHER
Amid deafening silence from G4S on the great escape.. the not-for-profit investigative news agency GroundUp got a tip-off in October last year.

The team, including Marecia Damons, chased down proof.
MARECIA DAMONS - GROUNDUP

09:40 – According to the autopsy report, when the post-mortem was performed on the body after the fire had worked out, it was indicated that that individual who had died in the fire was about 1.45 meters, and the discrepancy comes in because Thabo Bester, his height was just over 1.7 meters.
GroundUp revealed that the body inside cell 35 had been dead before the fire started.

Then, in March this year, social media exploded as a photo of Bester out shopping with his accomplice, Dr Nandipha, went viral. It also emerged he’d been running a business.
MARECIA DAMONS - GROUNDUP

17:10 – … Thabo Bester was involved in a a construction company called Aaron Properties. 17:31 –, but it was mainly over video calls.. 17:47 all of these business dealings had taken place the months after he had supposedly died in May of 2022.

Close to a year after Bester’s prison break, and amid a mounting public uproar, Police Minister, Bheki Cele, finally spoke out and admitted to what many already knew.

Bheki Cele Video - UPSOUND

“We believe that the doctor herself couldn't have done it alone”
BREATHER
LINK - According to G4S, the Mangaung Correctional Center is a maximum security prison and the second-largest private prison in the world. It was the first of its kind in our country and was introduced as a way to eradicate overcrowding in South African prisons. It all sounds good on paper but Bester’s recent escape has raised questions about the validity of privately run prisons.
BREATHER
G4S dismissed three employees for Bester’s escape. One of them was this man: the prison’s controversial former security supervisor, Senohe Matsoara.

According to Inmate X, Matsoara behaved suspiciously on the morning of the fire - apparently distracted by his cell phone while colleagues were dealing with the emergency.

SOUND UP - PRISONER X

12:53 It’s one of the things that made almost all of us suspicious that there’s 13:23 something wrong here.

BREATHER

But, for his plan to succeed, Bester would need someone on the outside, too.

NANDI - UPSOUND UPSOUND - Dr Magudumana

“I was six years old when I told my father that I want to be a doctor.

And that is where it’s alleged Dr Nandipha fits in.

A successful medical professional who described herself in this interview as a loving mother and passionate dermatologist, her fall has been spectacular.

- PICTURES
A camera shy Dr Nandipha appeared in court this week where she’s facing several charges including… murder.

UPSOUND FROM FOOTAGE

With her in the dock was a prison official responsible for CCTV cameras.
BREATHER
DR GERARD LABUSCHAGNE – FORENSIC PSYCHOLOGIST

CLAIRE - 08:10 – A lot of people are trying to make sense of the actions of his partner, Dr. Nandi Magudumana...

LABUSCHAGNE - 08:53 – … it's not uncommon where we see people who date people who are already convicted, meet them while they're in prison and end up in relationships and marry them, etc. 10:30 – ... she might feel there's true love. For him I could say if I look at his background I would have a huge question mark hang you over his feelings towards her.

BREATHER
LINK - Located in the affluent suburb of Hyde Park, this is the multi million rand home where Thabo Bester and Dr Nandi Magudumana allegedly lived.following revelations that have since come to light the couple have since abandoned their home.
BREATHER
Despite a tense manhunt across the continent, Bester, Magudumana and an accomplice made it all the way to Tanzania.

UPS COURT

Adding another twist to an already twisted tale, Dr Nandipha’s father, Zolile Sekeleni appeared in court days before his daughter, charged with murder and defeating the ends of justice. His co-accused was none other than former G4S employee, Senohe Matsoara.

BREATHER

… and days later, G4S faced the country’s Parliamentarians.
SOUND UP - PARLY SESSION

G4S Official : “The incident as you pointed out was reported on the 29th of April last year. It became known to the DCS through an affidavit, filed by one of our employees in mid-november this incident was raised for the first time”.

MP: So why did it take so long?

G4S Official : My view is that you are evading responsibility here. you are ducking all the institutional and systemic issues and responsibility in this matter.


UPS COURT FOR BESTER’S APPEARANCE

Last in line for a court appearance was Bester himself. Dressed in a tracksuit, he claimed to be a target for poisoning in his new prison, Pretoria’s Kgosi Mampuru. He’s facing charges of escaping from lawful custody, defeating the ends of justice, violation of a dead body and fraud.

G4S meanwhile claims CCTV cameras weren’t working on the day of the fire, that in any event, Bester’s cell was located in a camera blind spot, and that warden Matsoara ignored all phone calls.

Other questions remain unanswered. Notably whose body was engulfed by flames in cell 35? ENDS

With the police on his trail, he’d enticed another woman - Nomfundo Tyholo - into his grasp. He raped and then murdered her. PAUSE It was this unthinkable crime that led to his conviction… and how he crossed paths with one of the country’s leading Forensic Psychologists, Dr Gerard Labuschagne. VIDEO CLIP UPSOUND – Thabo interviewed by Dr Labuschagne – strap the video with the year 2011 4 Dr Labuschagne interviewed Bester ahead of his first court appearance. 15:31 - I’m sitting in a position where I want this thing to pass as soon as possible… Gerard – 14:05 – 14:16 I think that’s Thabo Bester in his purest conman formwhen did you decide you don’t want to put people through suffering? Because you’ve been putting people through suffering quite a lot, very repeatedly, in various different ways for years. 14:28 - 14:41 Now we must suddenly believe you, that you feel very bad about what you've done? It's nonsense. 4 Bester was sentenced to life for Tyholo’s murder, 50-years on two counts of rape and a further 15 for armed robbery. But, if he had his way - as he very nearly did - he had no intention of serving that sentence. A decade into his time behind bars, Bester would stage a prison escape so brazen, so audacious, that it defied belief. 5. LINK - Initially authorities believed Thabo Bester died after setting himself alight in May last year. But DNA tests revealed the charred remains found in the convicted rapist and murderer’s cell belonged to someone else. But this was information that prisoners inside knew before it was made public. 6. In a plan that reads like a movie script, it appears that a body - still not identified - was smuggled into Bester’s cell before being set alight. In the fire’s aftermath the official line remained that Bester had died in the flames. Others, though, knew better. This prisoner, who we’ll call Inmate X, shared the same unit as Bester, and claims the events leading to the fire were suspicious. So scared about the consequences of talking to us, he insisted we hide his identity. PAUSE We’ve asked an actor to voice what Inmate X told us in our recorded interview. SOUND UP - PRISONER EX. 32:48 The manner in which I know him, he was very quiet guy but you could see that he has everything. he was carrying a roll of money. He said if you have money you will get everything. 7. Inmate X tells us that, after initially being held in the prison’s common area, Bester was mysteriously moved into solitary confinement on the 30th of April last year. UPSOUND - Inmate X 05:44 There was something unusual that happened. 06:00 There was a guy staying in cell 35, whom before Bester arrived, the guy was then told to leave that cell. Then the guy refused, wanting to know the reasons behind it. 8.He was forced out to make way for Bester. Now a resident of Cell 35, the infamous Facebook rapist told anyone who asked that his stay would be a short one. UPSOUND X - INMATE 08:20 He was staying there as an own safety and we kept on going to him to ask how he was. But he mentioned something whereby he said to me,‘I’m just here, but soon I’ll be gone’. PAUSE… 10. Then, just 3 days after being moved - in the early hours of the 3rd of May - the prisoners were woken by an explosion. SOUND UP - INMATE X 09:37 As we were sleeping, around 2am, just after 2am that’s when we heard an explosion. 09:54 After that explosion we all woke up, even other inmates. 10:00 We could all smell the petrol and opened the windows while questioning what was going on. Everyone could smell the petrol, but we didn’t know where it was coming from. 11. Inmate X says he and the other prisoners pushed the panic buttons in their cells while smoke billowed from cell 35. 12 VO Then, about 30 minutes later… more panic. INMATE X 11:33 “Between 20 to 40 minutes later we heard a second explosion…worse than the first one. The other guys in front where now screaming for help. 14:24 “We then overheard from the nurses that he is dead.” 13. That “he” was Bester - or so they thought. 14. While prison officials stuck to their conclusions, it didn’t take much for the inmates to draw their own: the charred remains in cell 35 didn’t belong to Bester. SOUND UP - INMATE X 32:26 they knew because some of them he told them that he will be leaving. VO 13 – But whose body did they carry out of cell 35? And, just as crucially, how did it get into this maximum security prison in the first place? The answer, says Inmate X, might lie in the arrival before the fire of a mysterious wooden box. INMATE X 22:20 “This wooden kist was taken from the bakkie to the kitchen. VO 14 Could it be that Whatever or WHOMever was inside the kist was rolled into cell 35 on the evening of the fire…and later… rolled out by senior officials? BREATHER VO Thabo Bester was now at large. BREATHER VO: And yet, that a convicted rapist and murder was on the loose was kept from the public. The question is: why? OUR SOURCES SAY THAT PRISON OFFICIALS KNEW ABOUT THIS EARLIER… BREATHER The government spends nearly a billion rand a month on the London-listed security giant G4S to run two private prisons in South Africa. Police and Prisons Civil Rights Union spokesperson Richard Mamabolo believes the months-long cover-up is a sign of the corruption in private prisons. RICHARD MAMABOLO - POPCRU 05:03 – ..., it's humanly impossible for anybody to escape from that prison except through the help of perhaps the individuals and…you had to get the body inside the prison, into the cell again and you had to then get Mr Bester out. BREATHER OVER GVs UPS RUTH Author & journalist Ruth Hopkins has investigated the prison system - and Mangaung in particular for a decade. She co-produced a documentary called, Prison for Profit. RUTH HOPKINS – AUTHOR 01:56 –... prisoners started telling me stories about widespread torture, forced injections with antipsychotic drugs and murder that had taken place in the prison, a lot of other suspicious deaths. 05:55 – ...I visited about 20, 25 prisons in South Africa for my work and I would say Mangaung prison is a most violent and cruel prison, a most lawless prison that I’ve come across. Inmate X says he tried and failed to raise the alarm with prison authorities about the fire and what he believed to be Bester’s escape. SOUND UP - PRISONER X 30:12 I’ve got a letter which I wrote to the controllers on the 11th of July, whereby I demanded to see them with regards to this thing of Bester. 30:16 I asked them: ‘what are your thoughts with regard to this? Because this is not suicide, this is is an escape.’ Far from taking action, Inmate X says his identity was exposed and his safety compromised. He was transferred from Mangaung Prison to another facility. BREATHER Amid deafening silence from G4S on the great escape.. the not-for-profit investigative news agency GroundUp got a tip-off in October last year. The team, including Marecia Damons, chased down proof. MARECIA DAMONS - GROUNDUP 09:40 – According to the autopsy report, when the post-mortem was performed on the body after the fire had worked out, it was indicated that that individual who had died in the fire was about 1.45 meters, and the discrepancy comes in because Thabo Bester, his height was just over 1.7 meters. GroundUp revealed that the body inside cell 35 had been dead before the fire started. Then, in March this year, social media exploded as a photo of Bester out shopping with his accomplice, Dr Nandipha, went viral. It also emerged he’d been running a business. MARECIA DAMONS - GROUNDUP 17:10 – … Thabo Bester was involved in a a construction company called Aaron Properties. 17:31 –, but it was mainly over video calls.. 17:47 all of these business dealings had taken place the months after he had supposedly died in May of 2022. Close to a year after Bester’s prison break, and amid a mounting public uproar, Police Minister, Bheki Cele, finally spoke out and admitted to what many already knew. Bheki Cele Video - UPSOUND “We believe that the doctor herself couldn't have done it alone” BREATHER LINK - According to G4S, the Mangaung Correctional Center is a maximum security prison and the second-largest private prison in the world. It was the first of its kind in our country and was introduced as a way to eradicate overcrowding in South African prisons. It all sounds good on paper but Bester’s recent escape has raised questions about the validity of privately run prisons. BREATHER G4S dismissed three employees for Bester’s escape. One of them was this man: the prison’s controversial former security supervisor, Senohe Matsoara. According to Inmate X, Matsoara behaved suspiciously on the morning of the fire - apparently distracted by his cell phone while colleagues were dealing with the emergency. SOUND UP - PRISONER X 12:53 It’s one of the things that made almost all of us suspicious that there’s 13:23 something wrong here. BREATHER But, for his plan to succeed, Bester would need someone on the outside, too. NANDI - UPSOUND UPSOUND - Dr Magudumana “I was six years old when I told my father that I want to be a doctor. And that is where it’s alleged Dr Nandipha fits in. A successful medical professional who described herself in this interview as a loving mother and passionate dermatologist, her fall has been spectacular. - PICTURES A camera shy Dr Nandipha appeared in court this week where she’s facing several charges including… murder. UPSOUND FROM FOOTAGE With her in the dock was a prison official responsible for CCTV cameras. BREATHER DR GERARD LABUSCHAGNE – FORENSIC PSYCHOLOGIST CLAIRE - 08:10 – A lot of people are trying to make sense of the actions of his partner, Dr. Nandi Magudumana... LABUSCHAGNE - 08:53 – … it's not uncommon where we see people who date people who are already convicted, meet them while they're in prison and end up in relationships and marry them, etc. 10:30 – ... she might feel there's true love. For him I could say if I look at his background I would have a huge question mark hang you over his feelings towards her. BREATHER LINK - Located in the affluent suburb of Hyde Park, this is the multi million rand home where Thabo Bester and Dr Nandi Magudumana allegedly lived.following revelations that have since come to light the couple have since abandoned their home. BREATHER Despite a tense manhunt across the continent, Bester, Magudumana and an accomplice made it all the way to Tanzania. UPS COURT Adding another twist to an already twisted tale, Dr Nandipha’s father, Zolile Sekeleni appeared in court days before his daughter, charged with murder and defeating the ends of justice. His co-accused was none other than former G4S employee, Senohe Matsoara. BREATHER … and days later, G4S faced the country’s Parliamentarians. SOUND UP - PARLY SESSION G4S Official : “The incident as you pointed out was reported on the 29th of April last year. It became known to the DCS through an affidavit, filed by one of our employees in mid-november this incident was raised for the first time”. MP: So why did it take so long? G4S Official : My view is that you are evading responsibility here. you are ducking all the institutional and systemic issues and responsibility in this matter. UPS COURT FOR BESTER’S APPEARANCE Last in line for a court appearance was Bester himself. Dressed in a tracksuit, he claimed to be a target for poisoning in his new prison, Pretoria’s Kgosi Mampuru. He’s facing charges of escaping from lawful custody, defeating the ends of justice, violation of a dead body and fraud. G4S meanwhile claims CCTV cameras weren’t working on the day of the fire, that in any event, Bester’s cell was located in a camera blind spot, and that warden Matsoara ignored all phone calls. Other questions remain unanswered. Notably whose body was engulfed by flames in cell 35? ENDS

metadata.Unique Selling Point: It was widely reported that Thabo Bester, convicted rapist and murderer, was killed during a fire in Mangaung Prison in May last year. But GroundUp revealed the body found was dead before the fire broke out. The autopsy report obtained by them showed that it was because of blunt force injury. And that the police docket relating to the matter had been changed from suicide to murder. Several sources and leaks unveiled further suspicious circumstances around the fire…
metadata.Summary: That Betser was moved to a corner cell of the prison before the fire broke out, the cell was located where CCTV cameras could not look into. The man who died, did not die from the fire but rather the blow to the head. Minutes before the prison fire, two people were seen leaving the prison CCTV cameras where not positioned properly on the morning of the fire The autopsy report puts the heit of the body 25 centimeters shorter than Betser’s prison mugshot. The DNA of the body did not match that of the woman who claimed to be Bester’s mother. She had tried to claim the body. The body has not confirmed whether the body has been positively identified as Bester or not. The involvement of celebrity doctor Nandipha Mangudumana with a big social media following. She filed a case with the Pretoria High Court two days after the fire, claiming to be Bester’s customary wife, so that she can conduct her own investigations. Images of a man who looks like Bester submitted by an anonymous source in Sandton City. the picture appears to be of Thabo Bester and he seems to be accompanied by the celebrity doctor. This picture was taken on the 30th of June 2022 and the fire broke out on the 3rd of June 2022. Two months after the fire. The Judicial Inspectorate for Correctional Services has been investigating the Thabo Bester issue. At this stage the watchdog body says it's investigating all possible angles of the story. But they rely a lot on information provided by the police and correctional services. They cannot confirm until the police investigation is complete. The body says it's very concerned about the mounting evidence presented by the media and the public.
metadata.Further information: These allegations imply that a lot of people may have been involved in the alleged escape of Bester. It's an unsolved mystery that has Bester’s victims and those who say they have had encounters with the man worried.
